summary: This Audio class is a comprehensive UI page object model for testing HP audio control features on Windows. It inherits from HPXRebrandingFlow and provides extensive automation methods for audio settings including: (1) Audio presets (Music, Movie, Voice, RPG, Shooter, Strategy, Auto), (2) AI noise removal and reduction toggles, (3) Input/output device selection and volume control, (4) EQ slider adjustments across multiple frequency bands, (5) Microphone modes (Conference, Personal, Studio Recording), (6) Advanced audio settings including speaker swap, adaptive audio, and external speaker configuration, (7) Application-specific audio profiles, (8) MEP (Microsoft Effects Platform) integration, (9) DTS Sound Unbound features, (10) Multistreaming toggle, (11) Notification handling for audio changes. The class uses Selenium WebDriver for UI automation, includes screenshot comparison decorators for visual validation, implements retry logic with scrolling for element visibility, and provides SSH command execution for app installation via Task Scheduler. Notable patterns include conditional element checking (on/off states), keyboard navigation for sliders (LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN keys), timeout-based waits, and device-specific locators for different hardware configurations (Willie Robotics, Gidget, Arti, Thompson, London, Divinity, Snowball, Quardo, DTS platforms).
